description: Trigger: peering/pipeline.rs inserts into the articles table with ON CONFLICT (cid) DO NOTHING. If the same CID arrives via a different message path (e.g. cross-posted article with different Newsgroups header, or an article relayed through a different peer), the second insertion is silently ignored. Bad behavior: the articles table row retains the group_name from the first insertion, not from subsequent arrivals. GC tracking uses this group_name to evaluate pin policy — the wrong group means GC may incorrectly keep or delete the article based on the wrong group's policy.
title: articles ON CONFLICT (cid) DO NOTHING silently drops group_name for duplicate CID
